summary: Procedural hex lantern in build.py (no imports; geometry from blueprint numbers): body with 8 mm corner posts and rails, 5 glass panes (2 mm), stepped hex roof, footed base, 32 mm ring handle, wax candle with emissive flame, brass door with glass on a left hinge at (-38,-80) and a door_open action rotating it 0 to -90 deg about Z. Materials brass_/glass_/wax_/flame_ from materials.json. 9 meshes, 5500 triangles, 0 non-manifold edges. Silhouette proxy (own rasterisation; npm run selfcheck unavailable): worst IoU about 0.974.
